title: 11-Day Turkey & Egypt Ancient Wonders Route
metaTitle: Ephesus to Cairo | 11-Day Ancient Wonders Tour
metaDescription: Travel from Istanbul through Cappadocia, Ephesus and Pamukkale before continuing to Cairo on an 11-day route linking two ancient civilizations.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 11-Day Turkey & Egypt Trip connects Istanbul, Cappadocia and Turkey’s Aegean heritage with Cairo’s ancient sites. Begin in Istanbul before flying to Cappadocia, then continue to Pamukkale and Ephesus for two very different archaeological experiences. After completing the Turkey portion, fly to Cairo for the Pyramids of Giza and the city’s scheduled historical sightseeing. The route keeps the journey focused on Turkey’s major cultural highlights and Cairo rather than adding a Nile cruise or southern Egypt.
The escorted program includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, guided sightseeing, entrance fees, airport transfers, three domestic flights within the itinerary and the international Istanbul–Cairo flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Arrival in Istanbul via Istanbul Airport (IST) or Sabiha Gökçen International Airport (SAW).
Meet and transfer to your hotel. Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise - Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia tour- Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Visit Ephesus and House of Virgin Mary
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale tour - Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, transfer to Denizli Airport for your flight to Istanbul at 21:15. Upon arrival at 22:35, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Cairo / By Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Cairo (14:00–15:20).
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Tour to Pyramids and Sphinx.
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza. Transfer back to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Grand Egyptian Museum, Old Cairo Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before continuing to the historic Cairo Citadel and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Explore Old Cairo and visit the Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church and the Hanging Church. Later, enjoy free time at the famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Cairo
Check-out and transfer to Cairo International Airport according to your flight schedule

faqs.q: What does the 11-Day Turkey and Egypt vacation cover?
faqs.a: This 11-day vacation combines four Turkish destinations with Egypt's capital. You explore Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and Ephesus in Turkey, then fly to Cairo to see the Pyramids of Giza. The trip runs for 10 nights and 11 days and is available daily all year round.

faqs.q: How is this 11-day trip different from the other 11-day Turkey and Egypt tour?
faqs.a: This version focuses on covering more of Turkey, including Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and Ephesus alongside Istanbul, before visiting Cairo and the Pyramids. The other 11-day tour spends more time in Egypt with a Nile cruise from Aswan to Luxor. Choose this one for broader Turkey coverage and the alternative for a deeper Egypt and Nile experience.

faqs.q: How much does the 11-Day Turkey and Egypt vacation cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 2,875 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes 10 nights of accommodation, guided tours, entrance fees, lunches on tour days, domestic flights, the international flight from Istanbul to Cairo, and transfers

faqs.q: Are flights included in this Turkey and Egypt vacation?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights within Turkey connecting Istanbul, Cappadocia, and Izmir, plus the international flight from Istanbul to Cairo. International flights into Istanbul and out of Cairo are not included and are arranged by you.

faqs.q: What are the main highlights of this 11-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Highlights include Istanbul's Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque, the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia, the thermal terraces of Pamukkale, the ancient ruins of Ephesus and the House of the Virgin Mary, and the Pyramids of Giza in Cairo. It blends Turkey's top sights with Egypt's most famous monument.

faqs.q: What accommodation is provided on the 11-day vacation?
faqs.a: The package includes 10 nights at 4-star hotels on a bed and breakfast basis, with all airport and hotel transfers in both Turkey and Egypt. Hotels are selected for comfort and convenient locations near the main attractions.

faqs.q: Is the Cappadocia hot air balloon ride included?
faqs.a: No, the hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia is not included in the standard package. It is a popular optional add-on, subject to weather conditions, and our team can help you arrange it as an extra during your time in Cappadocia.

faqs.q: How physically demanding is this tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Expect regular walking at sites such as Ephesus, Pamukkale, the Cappadocia valleys, and the Pyramids, along with several internal flights and some early starts. Reasonable fitness makes the experience more comfortable.

faqs.q: Are meals included on the 11-day Turkey and Egypt vacation?
faqs.a: Lunches are included on guided tour days and breakfast is provided daily at the hotels. Dinners, drinks during meals, and any meals not listed in the itinerary are not included, leaving evenings free to explore local dining.

faqs.q: Can this 11-day Turkey and Egypt vacation be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the itinerary can be customized. You can add a Nile cruise, upgrade hotels, extend your stay in any city, or include the Cappadocia balloon ride. Contact Magnificent Travel with your dates and group size for a personalized plan.
